title: Feelings & support
goal: Notice when a friend is down and cheer them up, own up to a mistake and say sorry properly, congratulate someone and offer condolences.
intro:
Friendships are made in the moments when something goes wrong — or very right. This unit gives you what Marathi speakers really say when a friend is stressed (**टेन्शन घेऊ नकोस**), hurt (**मनावर घेऊ नकोस**), grieving (**हे ऐकून खूप वाईट वाटलं**) or celebrating (**मला तुझा अभिमान वाटतो!**).

On the grammar side you'll see how Marathi lets feelings *happen to* you (**मला रडू आलं** 'I burst into tears'), how to say *while*, *as soon as* and *until* with the compact endings **-ताना**, **-ताच** and **-ईपर्यंत**, and the very Marathi way of owning up: **माझं चुकलं** 'I was wrong'.

grammar.title: Feelings that happen to you: मला रडू आलं, मला वाईट वाटलं
grammar.body:
In Unit 14 you met **मला राग आला** 'I got angry' and **मला कंटाळा आला** 'I got bored'. Marathi treats most feelings not as something *you* do but as something that **happens to you**. The person who feels takes the dative **-ला** (मला, तुला, त्याला, तिला, आम्हाला), the feeling is the grammatical subject, and the verb agrees with the **feeling**.

Three verbs do most of the work:

**येणे** 'come' — a feeling that wells up: राग येणे 'get angry', **रडू** येणे 'burst into tears', **हसू** येणे 'burst out laughing', टेन्शन येणे 'get stressed', X-ची **आठवण** येणे 'miss X', झोप येणे 'feel sleepy'.
**वाटणे** 'feel, seem' — a state or impression: वाईट वाटणे 'feel bad, be sorry', बरं वाटणे 'feel better', भीती वाटणे 'be scared', काळजी वाटणे 'be worried', एकटं वाटणे 'feel lonely', X-चा **अभिमान** वाटणे 'be proud of X', X-चा **हेवा** वाटणे 'envy X'.
**होणे / बसणे** — an emotion that occurs: आनंद होणे 'be glad', दुःख होणे 'be sad', धक्का बसणे 'be shocked'.

Tense works as usual: मला रडू **आलं** (just now), मला तुझी आठवण **येते** (often), आठवण **येतेय** (right now).

The cause comes first with **-ऊन** 'having…': हे **ऐकून** वाईट वाटलं 'I felt bad hearing this', तुला **बघून** आनंद झाला 'I'm glad to see you'.

**The trap:** never मी वाईट वाटलो. And agreement follows the feeling noun, including the -चा/-ची of the person: तुझा अभिमान (m) वाटतो, तुझी आठवण (f) येते, रडू (n) आलं, धक्का (m) बसला.

examples.en: I was shocked to hear this news.

grammar.title: 'While', 'as soon as' and 'until': -ताना, -ताच, -ईपर्यंत
grammar.body:
Marathi links two actions in time with short endings glued to the verb stem instead of separate words.

**-ताना — while**
stem + **ताना**: जेव**ताना** 'while eating', गाडी चालव**ताना** 'while driving', ये**ताना** 'on the way here', जा**ताना** 'on the way there'. गाडी चालवताना फोन बघू नकोस 'don't look at your phone while driving'.

**-ताच — as soon as**
stem + **ताच**: घरी पोहोच**ताच** मेसेज कर 'text me as soon as you get home'. In relaxed speech people more often double the **-ल्या** form of the past: पोहोच**ल्या** पोहोच**ल्या** 'the moment you arrive', आल्या आल्या 'the moment (he) came'. It follows the past tense, so irregular verbs stay irregular: ये → आल्या, जा → गेल्या, कर → केल्या, हो → झाल्या.

**-ईपर्यंत / -एपर्यंत — until**
After a vowel stem add **ईपर्यंत**: ये → **येईपर्यंत**, जा → जाईपर्यंत, हो → होईपर्यंत. After a consonant stem add **एपर्यंत**: कर → करेपर्यंत, संप → संपेपर्यंत, पोहोच → पोहोचेपर्यंत. मी येईपर्यंत थांब 'wait until I come'. No negative is needed.

**जोपर्यंत … तोपर्यंत — as long as**
जोपर्यंत मी इथे आहे, तोपर्यंत काळजी करू नकोस 'as long as I'm here, don't worry'. To mean *until* with this pattern Marathi uses a **negative**, literally 'as long as X doesn't happen': जोपर्यंत तो माफी मागत **नाही**, तोपर्यंत मी बोलणार नाही 'until he apologises, I won't speak to him'.

**The trap:** the **-ईपर्यंत** form never takes नाही; the **जोपर्यंत** form does when you mean 'until'. With a time or place, 'until' is just **पर्यंत** (Unit 11): संध्याकाळपर्यंत, घरापर्यंत.

examples.en: Don't look at your phone while you're driving.
Bring some milk on your way here.
Text me as soon as you get home.

grammar.title: Owning a mistake: माझं चुकलं, माझ्याकडून चूक झाली
grammar.body:
Marathi has several ways to say 'I made a mistake', and the choice shows how sorry you are and whether you meant it.

**मी चूक केली** — 'I made a mistake'. Plain and factual; with something you broke it can sound deliberate.
**माझं चुकलं** — literally 'mine went wrong'. This is the everyday, sincere 'I was wrong', used between friends, couples and with parents. Also **तुझं** चुकलं 'you were in the wrong', **कोणाचं** चुकलं? 'whose fault was it?'
**माझ्याकडून चूक झाली** — literally 'a mistake happened *from* me'. The doer takes **-कडून** 'from, by' and the verb is an intransitive one like होणे, फुटणे, पडणे. The message is: *I did it, but not on purpose.* माझ्याकडून कप **फुटला** 'I (accidentally) broke the cup' — compare मी कप फोडला 'I broke the cup', which sounds deliberate. **चुकून** 'by mistake' often goes with it.

In the negative the same pattern means 'I just can't (bring myself to)': माझ्याकडून हे **होणार नाही** 'I can't do this'.

A ladder of apologies, light to heavy: **सॉरी** (bumping into someone) → **माझं चुकलं** (owning up) → **मला माफ कर / करा** (asking forgiveness) → **मी मनापासून माफी मागतो / मागते** (sincere, also formal). Add **मी मुद्दाम नाही केलं** 'I didn't do it on purpose'. The usual replies: **जाऊ दे**, **सोडून दे**, **असं होतं** 'it happens', **काही हरकत नाही**.

examples.en: Sorry, this time I was in the wrong.

examples.native: तिच्याकडून चूक झाली, पण तिने मुद्दाम नाही केलं.
examples.roman: tichyākaḍūn tsūk dzhālī, paṇ tine muddām nāhī kelaṃ.
examples.en: She made a mistake, but she didn't do it on purpose.

culture:
Comfort in Marathi is practical more than wordy. Friends say **काळजी करू नकोस, मी आहे ना** and then *do* something: order cutting chai, turn up at the door, sit with you. **होतं असं** 'it happens' and **जाऊ दे रे** 'let it go' are the classic shrugs. Between close friends, too many thank-yous and sorries sound distant; with parents, elders and at work, switch to **माफ करा** and **मी माफी मागतो / मागते**.

Good news brings an immediate demand. In Maharashtra the traditional way to share it — passing an exam, a new job, an engagement, a baby — is to hand out **पेढे** (milk sweets), so friends ask **पेढे कधी?** as often as **पार्टी कधी?**. Saying **मला तुझा हेवा वाटतो** to a friend with good news is a compliment, not a complaint.

When someone dies, people go to the family's home to sit with them (no flowers or gifts), speak of the person in the respectful plural (**ते वारले**) and keep words few: **खूप वाईट वाटलं**. On WhatsApp and Facebook you will see **भावपूर्ण श्रद्धांजली** 'heartfelt tribute' and **ॐ शांती** under the photo. Hindu families observe mourning rites up to the तेरावा (thirteenth day), so avoid inviting them to celebrations in that time.

tip.title: मला रडू आलं — feelings happen to you
tip.body:
- The person who feels takes **-ला**: मला, तुला, तिला, सगळ्यांना.
- The feeling is the subject: **रडू येणे** 'cry', **हसू येणे** 'laugh', **आठवण येणे** 'miss', **एकटं वाटणे** 'feel lonely', **दुःख होणे** 'be sad'.
- The verb agrees with the **feeling**: रडू (n) **आलं**, आठवण (f) **येते**.
- Never मी वाईट वाटलो.

tip.title: Don't worry: -ऊ नकोस
tip.body:
- 'Don't…' to a friend: stem + **ऊ नकोस**: काळजी करू **नकोस**, रडू **नकोस**.
- To तुम्ही or an elder: **नका**: काळजी करू **नका**.
- **ना** adds warmth: **मी आहे ना** 'I'm here for you'.
- **बिचारा / बिचारी** 'poor thing' agrees with the person.

sentences.native: काळजी करू नकोस, मी आहे ना.
sentences.roman: kāḷjī karū nakos, mī āhe nā.
sentences.en: Don't worry, I'm here.
Don't worry, uncle.
Look after yourself, hang in there.

sentences.native: मी त्याला समजावलं, पण तो ऐकत नाही.
sentences.roman: mī tyālā samdzāvlaṃ, paṇ to aikat nāhī.
sentences.en: I tried to talk him round, but he won't listen.
Don't cry, it'll all be OK.
Don't take what he says to heart.
Don't stress about tomorrow's interview.

tip.title: माझं चुकलं — owning a mistake
tip.body:
- **माझं चुकलं** 'I was wrong' — the everyday, sincere way to own up.
- **माझ्याकडून** + intransitive verb = I did it, but not on purpose: माझ्याकडून चूक **झाली**, माझ्याकडून कप **फुटला**.
- **मी चूक केली** is plainer and can sound deliberate.
- Replies: **जाऊ दे**, **सोडून दे**, **असं होतं**.

sentences.en: Sorry, I was in the wrong yesterday.
I accidentally broke your bottle.

sentences.native: आई, माझ्याकडून चूक झाली, मला माफ कर.
sentences.roman: āī, mājhyākaḍūn tsūk dzhālī, malā māph kar.
sentences.en: Mum, I made a mistake, forgive me.

sentences.native: त्याने मुद्दाम केलं असं मला वाटत नाही.
sentences.roman: tyāne muddām kelaṃ asaṃ malā vāṭat nāhī.
sentences.en: I don't think he did it on purpose.
I'm truly sorry. (man)

sentences.native: तिच्याकडून चुकून दार बंद झालं आणि किल्ली आत राहिली.
sentences.roman: tichyākaḍūn tsukūn dār band dzhālaṃ āṇi killī āt rāhilī.

sentences.native: माझ्याकडून हे काम आज होणार नाही.
sentences.roman: mājhyākaḍūn he kām ādz hoṇār nāhī.
sentences.en: I just can't get this done today.
You did nothing wrong.

tip.title: -ताना, -ताच, -ईपर्यंत
tip.body:
- stem + **ताना** = while: जेवताना, गाडी चालवताना.
- stem + **ताच** = as soon as: पोहोचताच फोन कर. In speech also **पोहोचल्या पोहोचल्या**.
- stem + **ईपर्यंत / एपर्यंत** = until: मी येईपर्यंत, काम संपेपर्यंत — no नाही.
- **जोपर्यंत … नाही, तोपर्यंत** = until (lit. as long as … not).

sentences.en: As soon as I heard the news I was in shock.

sentences.native: रात्री घरी जाताना मला फोन कर.
sentences.roman: rātrī gharī dzātānā malā fon kar.
sentences.en: Call me on your way home tonight.

sentences.native: घाबरू नकोस, डॉक्टर येईपर्यंत मी इथेच आहे.
sentences.roman: ghābarū nakos, ḍôkṭar yeīparyant mī ithets āhe.
sentences.en: Don't panic, I'm right here until the doctor comes.

sentences.native: तू शांत होईपर्यंत आपण इथे बसू.
sentences.roman: tū shānt hoīparyant āpaṇ ithe basū.
sentences.en: We'll sit here until you calm down.

sentences.native: जोपर्यंत तो सॉरी म्हणत नाही, तोपर्यंत मी त्याच्याशी बोलणार नाही.
sentences.roman: dzoparyant to sôrī mhaṇat nāhī, toparyant mī tyāchyāshī bolṇār nāhī.
sentences.en: Until he says sorry, I'm not talking to him.

sentences.native: ऑफिसला पोहोचल्या पोहोचल्या साहेबांनी मला बोलावलं.
sentences.roman: ôfislā pohotslyā pohotslyā sāhebānnī malā bolāvlaṃ.
sentences.en: The moment I got to the office, the boss called me in.
Don't watch TV while you're eating.

sentences.native: मी आहे, कधीही फोन कर, अगदी रात्री दोन वाजता सुद्धा.
sentences.roman: mī āhe, kadhīhī fon kar, agdī rātrī don vādztā suddhā.
sentences.en: I'm here — call any time, even at two in the morning.

sentences.native: जोपर्यंत तू इथे आहेस, तोपर्यंत मला काळजी नाही.
sentences.roman: dzoparyant tū ithe āhes, toparyant malā kāḷjī nāhī.
sentences.en: As long as you're here, I've nothing to worry about.
Calm down, drink some water first.

tip.title: Congratulations: अभिनंदन!
tip.body:
- **अभिनंदन!** or **खूप खूप अभिनंदन!** works for anything.
- Say what for with **-बद्दल**: नवीन नोकरीबद्दल अभिनंदन!
- 'Proud of you' and 'jealous of you' are feelings that happen to you: मला तुझा **अभिमान / हेवा** वाटतो.
- Expect to pay: **पार्टी कधी देतोयस?** or, traditionally, **पेढे कधी?**

sentences.en: Many congratulations on the new job!

sentences.native: परीक्षेचा निकाल लागला, मी पास झालो!
sentences.roman: parīkṣetsā nikāl lāglā, mī pās dzhālo!
sentences.en: The exam results are out — I passed! (man)
She finally got her promotion.
So today the treat's on you!

sentences.native: आई-बाबांना तुझा खूप अभिमान वाटत असेल.
sentences.roman: āī-bābānnā tudzhā khūp abhimān vāṭat asel.
sentences.en: Your parents must be so proud of you.

sentences.native: खरं सांगू? मला तुझा थोडा हेवा वाटतो!
sentences.roman: kharaṃ sāṅgū? malā tudzhā thoḍā hevā vāṭto!
sentences.en: Honestly? I'm a bit jealous of you!
This success is down to your hard work.
When's the promotion party?
Mum cried when she heard the result.

tip.title: Condolences and hard news
tip.body:
- Speak of the dead with respect, in the plural: आजोबा **वारले**, **त्यांच्या** आत्म्याला शांती लाभो.
- Keep it short: **हे ऐकून खूप वाईट वाटलं**.
- Offer help in the polite form: **काही मदत लागली तर सांगा**.
- A break-up is simply **ब्रेकअप झालं**.

sentences.en: My grandfather passed away last night.

sentences.native: तुझ्या आजीबद्दल ऐकून खूप वाईट वाटलं.
sentences.roman: tujhyā ājībaddal aikūn khūp vāīṭ vāṭlaṃ.
sentences.en: I'm so sorry to hear about your grandmother.

sentences.native: त्यांच्या निधनाची बातमी ऐकून धक्का बसला.
sentences.roman: tyānchyā nidhanāchī bātmī aikūn dhakkā baslā.
sentences.en: I was shocked to hear of his passing.

sentences.native: आम्ही संध्याकाळी त्यांच्या घरी जाणार आहोत.
sentences.roman: āmhī sandhyākāḷī tyānchyā gharī dzāṇār āhot.
sentences.en: We're going to their house this evening.

sentences.native: काही मदत लागली तर कधीही सांगा.
sentences.roman: kāhī madat lāglī tar kadhīhī sāṅgā.
sentences.en: If you need any help, just tell me, any time.
He and she have broken up.
He's been very isolated since the break-up.
Talk to him, he'll feel better.
We're all with you.
